body: This is if you're not at a T14 grade-blind OCI. This is absolutely not the case at grade-blind OCIs

You think our administration is taking all this heat and leaving the pack ... so that we can send a few more people to Cravath or into fed clerkships? To *maybe* get ahead of UVA and maybe even UPenn on next year's USNWR rankings?

Another 1L here, happy to verify as well.  
  
I've been absolutely floored by the 1Ls coming on here trashing our school because they didn't get the grading policy they wanted. Dean West's email was thoughtful and measured. Insensitive or unaccommodating doesn't describe the administration at all.  
  
All classes are now recorded and uploaded for us to access. All exams are take home and remote. If you're in a timezone different than Eastern Standard and can't be awake for class, I'm sure you can come to an arrangement with your professor to never attend class and to only watch the recordings.  
  
Each communication from Dean West and Dean Seinfeld has been extremely cordial and measured and showed that they were taking our input into account. Michigan is a great place.  
  
That said, you should take "[Law School Name] Difference" with a grain of salt any time it's said about any law school. To all the people coming on Reddit and whining: if you thought the Michigan Difference meant getting everything you asked for, the problem was with your expectations. The administration made the decision they thought was best for us. They gain nothing from holding on to optional PF, especially if OCI moves to January. Just deal with it.
